schema.axes: bipolar play-preference axes; value runs from -1 (the neg pole) to +1 (the pos pole)
schema.aesthetic_axes: bipolar taste axes, lower importance, mostly fed by threshold choices
schema.weights: families of independent weights; +1 means attracted, -1 means declined or avoided
schema.importance: how much the dimension matters to the final design when ranking signals (0..1)
schema.desc: one sentence shown to the narrator model so it files evidence on the right dimension

axes.desc: Wants clearly communicated objectives (guided) or prefers deciding what matters (self_directed).
Keeps seeking new situations (discovery) or enjoys understanding and perfecting a known system (mastery).
Gathers information and prepares before acting (deliberative) or commits happily with incomplete information (improvisational).
In play only: protects what they have (preservation) or enters unknown spaces, wagers and tests dangerous things (experimentation).
Failure feels like an interruption to avoid (failure_averse) or like information, comedy or an invitation to try again (failure_as_information).
How much resistance before reward they enjoy: retries, traversal, scarcity, delayed gratification, cryptic mechanics.
Wants a few expressive mechanics (minimal) or a dense interacting system (systemic).
Wants to be told (clarity) or enjoys unexplained phenomena, hidden rules and incomplete maps (mystery).
When the optimal choice conflicts with the funny, stylish, strange or personal one: takes the efficient one or the expressive one.
Engages with mechanisms first (systems_first) or with people, history and what happens next (narrative_first).
Desired density of decisions and events: lingers and breathes (contemplative) or wants the next thing now (relentless).
Prefers short complete episodes (bite_sized) or investing across a long arc (long_form). Infer from in-game investment, never from response delay.
Takes the route to the goal (goal_route) or opens optional rooms, backtracks, examines scenery and tests dead ends (exhaustive).
Enjoys tension from being fragile and threatened (vulnerability) or from being increasingly capable (power).
Prefers experiments that can be undone (reversible) or choices that stay made and a world that remembers (permanent).
Enjoys invisible relationships discovered by feel (opaque_emergent) or numbers, odds, meters and stated rules (transparent_calculable). Not the same as complexity.
Prefers being alone in the world (solo) or a world with people in it (populated).

reward.desc: What the player plays for. Attracted (+1) or declined when cheaply offered (-1).

items.mastery: getting measurably better at a known thing
items.collection: gathering and keeping things, sets, trophies
items.revelation: learning what happened or what it means
items.completion: finishing the set, clearing the list
items.creation: building or arranging something that stays
items.surprise: not knowing what comes out of the box
items.transgression: breaking the rule, finding the seam, misusing the machine

solve.desc: Which kind of problem-solving they reach for first and stay with.

items.experimentation: poking it to see what it does
items.optimization: finding the best line through known numbers
items.lateral: using a thing for what it was not meant for

conflict.desc: How they deal with something in the way. Never moralize these.

items.avoidance: go around, sneak, wait it out
items.negotiation: talk, trade, bargain in good faith
items.manipulation: trick, bluff, play one against another
items.tactical: prepare the ground, use the environment, set a trap
items.chaotic: make a mess and see what survives

soc.desc: Which social textures draw them when present.

items.companions: one being that travels with them
items.recurring: people who come back and remember
items.factions: groups with interests to side with or play off
items.simulation: people with needs and routines to observe or manage

tone.desc: Which emotional registers they prolong, return to, or lean into.

items.funny: jokes, wit, play with the narrator
items.mysterious: the unexplained, held at a distance
items.heroic: standing up, doing the brave thing
items.chaotic: noise, mess, too much at once

story.desc: Which kind of story interest shows up. A player may skip exposition and still love environmental storytelling.

items.character: who people are and what they want
items.world: the place, its history and rules, read from objects
items.plot: what happens next, promises and payoffs
items.emergent: the story their own actions made

arc.desc: Which shape of capability over time they lean toward.

items.capable_to_overwhelmed: start competent, get in over their head
items.wild_escalation: everything gets bigger and stranger, fast
items.strange: something that is not a power curve at all
